en: The postcard front shows the façade of a large Romanesque-style cathedral with two tall square towers flanking a long nave with a greenish copper roof. In the foreground are trees and a stepped plaza with people walking. An inset image at the top center depicts a richly decorated golden reliquary resembling a miniature Gothic chapel. The reverse side is a standard divided-back postcard layout with multilingual printed text describing a national display of the Holy Right Hand at the cathedral in Pécs in 1988.
